material_findings.title: PwnSec is live inside its published 24-hour event window
material_findings.summary: PwnSec's organizer-published window is Sep. 12 14:00 UTC through Sep. 13 14:00 UTC. The Cyborg faction may use scripts, agents and autonomous pipelines, but the faction lock was one hour before board open and has passed. Repository evidence does not establish that the user or any team registered/selected Cyborg before the lock.
material_findings.recommended_action: Keep the existing case in triage unless participant account/team/faction state is independently confirmed. If a valid Cyborg team is already registered, work only on event-provided challenges under organizer rules; otherwise do not infer late AI-lane eligibility.
